businesses.business: electrical power distribution and control equipment

offering_description.value: Powell designs and builds custom electrical equipment that distributes, protects, and controls power for energy producers, utilities, industrial facilities, data centers, and rail systems. It integrates equipment into prefabricated electrical buildings and provides field service throughout the equipment’s operating life.

primary_products.value: medium- and low-voltage switchgear and circuit breakers; prefabricated electrical buildings; motor control centers; bus duct; power monitoring and control systems

primary_services.value: installation and commissioning; inspection and testing; maintenance and repair; equipment retrofits and upgrades

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and gas producers, refiners, electric utilities, industrial plant operators, data center developers, and engineering and construction contractors; B2G: Public transit authorities and municipal electric utilities

end_markets.value: oil and gas, including refining and petrochemicals; electric utilities; data centers; industrial manufacturing; rail transit

revenue_model.value: product sales: Switchgear, control equipment, and replacement parts; project or contract: Engineered electrical distribution systems and prefabricated electrical buildings built to project specifications; service fees: Field commissioning, testing, repairs, and equipment upgrades
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds electrical distribution equipment from metal and electrical components for facility owners, utilities, and contractors; service provider: Tests, repairs, and upgrades installed electrical equipment for utilities and facility operators

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and other international project markets

specialization.value: related lines: Switchgear, integrated electrical buildings, motor controls, power monitoring, and field services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Project sales to facility owners, utilities, and engineering, procurement, and construction contractors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Equipment manufacturing and field installation are subject to workplace electrical safety rules and applicable electrical codes.
